desc: Perfect EDC. It features a drop-point blade of 8CR13MoV stainless steel, which Kershaw heat-treats to ensure its strength, hardness, and ability to hold a keen edge. That's paired with a lightweight Polyimide handle with sure-grip texturing. To make it even better, the Clash features SpeedSafe assisted opening, a Flipper, and is a excellent value.3½" blade. Closed: 4-1/4". Weight" 4 oz. 7-1/4" Overall.
